registration_boundary.purpose: Register source fingerprints, structural census, runtime, and deterministic interpretations before loading either frozen neural model for RGB scoring.

structural_census.candidate_normalization: Collapse Unicode whitespace with Python re \s+ and trim.
structural_census.source_deduplication: Deduplicate complete normalized source documents within each case before chunking; union source labels and en_int gold-group memberships.
structural_census.source_order: Sort deduplicated source documents by normalized-text SHA-256 before assigning neutral source ordinals, so original positive/negative list order cannot influence deterministic tie breaks.
structural_census.chunk_deduplication: Do not deduplicate partial chunks after source-document deduplication; a chunk retains the identity and memberships of its unique source document.

frozen_adapter_interpretation.case_id: dataset_id + '::' + public integer id; public IDs are non-empty and unique within every file.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.candidate_pool: Correct-positive, negative, and, for en_fact, positive_wrong source documents are all selectable after blind-field removal.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.normal_gold_units: Each deduplicated correct-positive source document is one gold unit.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.integration_gold_units: Each top-level en_int positive group is one gold unit; selecting a chunk from any member source document covers that unit.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.chunking: Encode normalized source text without special tokens; emit token windows [start:start+384] at stride 320; decode each window with skip_special_tokens=true and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.candidate_id: case_id + source-label-neutral SHA-256-sorted source ordinal + zero-based chunk ordinal; labels and gold memberships are never encoded in IDs.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.token_cost: Number of pre-decode content token IDs in the chunk.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.blind_cache: Prepared and scored caches contain query, candidate text/ID/source ID/token count, public dataset/capability, and neural scores only. Answers, labels, and gold memberships are absent.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.gold_join: Selectors emit candidate IDs for all methods and budgets before the raw source is reopened and labels are joined for evaluation.

frozen_scoring_execution.per_case_minmax: Apply independent min-max calibration across the candidates of one case for each query/prompt score vector; map a constant vector to zeros.
frozen_scoring_execution.dense: Normalized embedding dot product followed by per-case min-max.
frozen_scoring_execution.cross_encoder: Query-candidate logits followed by per-case min-max.
frozen_scoring_execution.role_score: 0.85 * calibrated role-prompt cross-encoder score + 0.15 * calibrated direct-query cross-encoder score.
frozen_scoring_execution.bm25: In-case BM25 over lowercase English alphanumeric/apostrophe tokens with k1=1.5, b=0.75, followed by per-case min-max.
frozen_scoring_execution.hybrid: Reciprocal-rank fusion of calibrated BM25 and dense ranks with RRF k=60, followed by per-case min-max.

frozen_selector_execution.cross_encoder_density: Greedy descending calibrated cross_encoder/token_count; ties by cross_encoder descending, token_count ascending, candidate_id ascending.
frozen_selector_execution.cross_encoder_knapsack: Exact 0/1 integer-cost dynamic programming for maximum sum of calibrated cross-encoder scores under count and token constraints; ties by lower token cost then lexicographically smaller selected-ID tuple.
frozen_selector_execution.coverage_greedy_proxy: Select the best feasible remaining candidate once for each registered role in role order, ties by cross-encoder descending then ID; fill by cross-encoder rank.

frc_select_v34.marginal_role_gain: For each role, gain 1.0 when the candidate first crosses 0.55; otherwise gain 0.25 * positive score improvement. Average role gains, multiply by 2, then add candidate cross-encoder score.
frc_select_v34.ranking: At each step choose maximum marginal value without dividing by token cost; tie by candidate_id.

frozen_selector_execution.frc_cost_aware_v35: Use the protocol-registered monotone set objective and marginal-gain-per-token greedy rule with singleton guard exactly as written in the protocol.
frozen_selector_execution.hard_budget_behavior: Ranked greedy methods skip an infeasible candidate and continue scanning; all methods return no more than five chunks and never exceed the requested token budget.

stopping_and_output.gate_boundary: The result cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
